description: This file defines the CommandHandler class which manages MQTT command subscriptions, unsubscriptions, and PUBACK handling within the Eclipse Hono MQTT adapter module. It includes methods for tracking command acknowledgements, managing subscription lifecycle, and handling timers for acknowledgement timeouts.

classes.name: CommandHandler
classes.description: Manages MQTT command subscriptions, acknowledgements, and timers for timeouts.

classes.name: PendingCommandRequest
classes.description: Stores information about a pending command acknowledgment, including timer ID, tenant info, subscription, and command context.

methods.name: handlePubAck
methods.description: Handles PUBACK packets by canceling timers and invoking post-acknowledgement actions.

methods.name: addToWaitingForAcknowledgement
methods.description: Tracks a message ID as waiting for acknowledgement with associated tenant, subscription, and command context.

methods.name: removeFromWaitingForAcknowledgement
methods.description: Removes an acknowledgment tracking entry for a given message ID.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Adds a new command subscription with associated message consumer.

methods.name: removeSubscription
methods.description: Removes a command subscription and invokes a consumer if provided.

methods.name: closeCommandConsumer
methods.description: Closes a command message consumer and logs the outcome.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer for command acknowledgement timeout and logs timeout events.
